legend: You are creating a tour of the Peak District hills for a friend visiting from the Netherlands. The walk will go from the locally famous viewpoint "Hill 1" to the world-famous viewpoint "Hill 2".
To make this friend feel at home, you want to minimise the difference in height between the highest and lowest hills of the walk.
Given a graph of the local points of interest and paths between them, find such an optimally-flat route.
input: One line containing the number of hills, n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤5000$$$2 \le n \le 5\,000$$$), and the number of trails connecting them, m$$$m$$$ (1≤m≤25000$$$1 \le m \le 25\,000$$$).
One line containing n$$$n$$$ integers h1…hn$$$h_1 \ldots h_n$$$ (0≤h≤106$$$0 \le h \le 10^6$$$), the heights in metres of the hills from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$.

m$$$m$$$ further lines, the i$$$i$$$-th of which contains two integers a$$$a$$$ and b$$$b$$$ (1≤a,b≤n$$$1 \le a, b \le n$$$) indicating that there is a bi-directional path between hills a$$$a$$$ and b$$$b$$$.
It is guaranteed that there is a path (direct or indirect) between hills 1$$$1$$$ and 2$$$2$$$.
output: Output the minimum possible distance between the maximum and minimum heights of hills encountered on a walk between hills 1$$$1$$$ and 2$$$2$$$.

legend.ai: 你正在为一位从荷兰来访的朋友规划一次峰区丘陵之旅。徒步路线将从当地著名的观景点“Hill 1”前往世界闻名的观景点“Hill 2”。
为了让这位朋友感到宾至如归，你希望最小化这条步行路线中最高山丘与最低山丘之间的高度差。
给定当地景点及其之间路径构成的图，找出一条平坦程度最优的路线。

input.ai: 一行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 h1…hn$$$h_1 \ldots h_n$$$(0≤h≤106$$$0 \le h \le 10^6$$$)，表示从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$ 号山丘的高度(单位：米)。
还有 m$$$m$$$ 行，第 i$$$i$$$ 行包含两个整数 a$$$a$$$ 和 b$$$b$$$(1≤a,b≤n$$$1 \le a, b \le n$$$)，表示山丘 a$$$a$$$ 与 b$$$b$$$ 之间存在一条双向路径。
保证山丘 1$$$1$$$ 和 2$$$2$$$ 之间存在一条路径(直接或间接)。

output.ai: 输出在山丘 1$$$1$$$ 和 2$$$2$$$ 之间行走时遇到的山丘最大高度与最小高度之差的可能最小值。
